statement: The stage-15 unordered-triangle dedup keys a duplicate on the three vertex POSITIONS as an unordered triple (the store's written point coordinates), not on element indices. Two triangles are one facet only when their three coordinates are identical; the index triple alone proves only the same-rep case, because the per-rep decomposition keeps element spaces disjoint, so a later rep re-listing an earlier rep's facet writes different indices for it. A bare index match never crosses index spaces.

statement: The keeper is the copy from the EARLIEST emission unit: the rep-space rank of the triangle's first vertex (space_offsets; ties by emission order). Emission order alone is not the rule - a rep's dup-pin welded loops are appended last.
